title: Source code for condition-dependent dynamic voltage–state-of-charge CALCE profiles
description: Source-aligned CALCE nominal-concordant cycle reconstruction, cell-clustered SoC-band inference, unified weighted-isotonic LUT validation (LOCO, rate and temperature hold-outs), fixed-prediction support analysis and five-representation comparison. Historical July 2026 source preserved in legacy.
